name: Buck's Rock Camp
description_short: Buck's Rock is a nonprofit overnight arts camp in New Milford, CT, for teens ages 11 to 17, with 32 visual and performing arts programs plus outdoor activities. In 2027 you can book the 8-week full season (July 1 to August 21), a 4-week first or second session, a 6-week session, or the CIT program. Tuition is tiered by household size and income, from $0 up to the full rate.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has a swimming pool on its wooded grounds.
